svg.title: Fixed-rate or adjustable-rate mortgage
svg.desc: A T-chart with 2 columns — Fixed-rate (4 points) and Adjustable-rate (4 points). Coloured headings sit above one heavy rule; each column's points lie on a pale panel of its colour, and a vertical rule runs down between the panels.
